ScIn/OpsComments 2013 optimisation of 84079-89 suggested for BPP-0.014 optimum bias I0Z210>bd:400 as 84079/80.\
In 2015 bias scan 89005-89011 suggested for BPP-0.014 better I0Z270>bd:400. An higher prefill reservoir pressure of 250MB GIM1 is recommended. The combination of 210A bias and low 200mb prefill has led to breakdown failures e.g 88943/45.   More recently on 89695/96/97 gave 3 NSBs with 210A bias and 250mBar (request, 230-240 actual). .

rtcc/network3title Duct pressure control
rtcc/network3desc Gate NBI power based on duct pressure measurement threshold\
When the duct pressure exceeds "OffThres", the NBI power is disabled. When the duct pressure falls to below "OnThres" the NBI power is re-enabled.\
A simulator based on a first order transfer function is used to demonstrate correct working of the algorithm. This simulator has arbitrary coefficients and is not derived from analysis of real machine dynamics. If the OffThres and OnThres values are changed the simulator will need to be adjusted.

rtcc/network4desc EFCC compensation lines 6-21\
Output is on ss1 make sure to remove the ss1 output from net 4\
Delayed DMV triggering lines 101-143\
This one is identical to the one in Network one apart from the output being delayed by 4ms and put on pp2 \
Delayed IpSpike/RR voltages only lines 145-156\
This one only uses the VLRRL*VLRRU and same normalised by Ip at reduced levels, delayed by 4ms and put on pp3
